sprint.name: Your Organization Projection Compatibility Adapter
sprint.classification: B — Compatibility Adapter Valid; Product Contract Refinement Required
sprint.scope: Pure inactive compatibility mapping from disclosed Organizational Understanding Projection into the existing Runtime-details contract.

evidence.claimBoundary: Forty-three deterministic compatibility, availability, identity, trace, replay, non-mutation, active-path, and rollback checks.
Field inventory, ownership, parity, communication boundary, disclosure activation interface, blockers, and rollback.
Existing product behavior, persisted Runtime replay, and non-mutation regression.
Resolved-decision disclosure, revocation, isolation, and truth noninterference.
Canonical DEPS evidence and reporting rules.

scorecard.rationale: The adapter reshapes existing projected cognition without creating, selecting, or revising Organizational Understanding.
The active product path is unchanged and no real-user or Local Understanding Utility outcome was measured.
No participation, contribution, cross-scope synthesis, or collective learning behavior changed.
The product compatibility boundary preserves fail-closed disclosure states and cannot refill protected gaps through Runtime traversal.
A thin reusable adapter isolates product shaping from Runtime traversal and keeps rollback local.

architecture.observation: Projection-to-product shaping is isolated from cognition, Runtime, disclosure decisions, communication synthesis, and UI composition.
Composition identity, revision, source revisions, decision identity, Explanation membership, canonical references, and Evidence roles survive compatibility shaping.
The Phase 8A Runtime adapter remains active and user-visible behavior is unchanged.

benchmarks.summary: The reusable projection compiler remains pure, deterministic, fail-closed, and inactive.
The compatibility adapter is deterministic, disclosure-state preserving, Runtime-independent, non-mutating, and inactive.
The active Runtime-backed experience and replay regression remain passing.
The disclosure contract remains passing and production decision generation remains unowned.

researchObservations.observation: No Organizational Understanding research dimension, Local Understanding Utility, or User Intelligence outcome was evaluated.

introduced: Optional backward-compatible availability, reference, and projection trace metadata.
complexity.justification: The bounded additions demonstrate a reversible migration boundary and expose the exact product-contract gap without duplicating Runtime traversal.

governanceObservations.observation: Compatibility preserves withheld, revoked, mismatch, invalid-authority, and historical states and has no Runtime fallback.

sustainabilityObservations.observation: The adapter proves reusable projection can feed the existing section shape with local rollback and no persistence migration.

regressions.observation: The active adapter remains selected and existing organization-experience output remains passing.

unknownsAndUnmeasured.reason: No owner currently supplies disclosed canonical headlines, summaries, evolution narrative, or a top-Explanation priority.
No production disclosure-decision producer or validity and revocation lifecycle exists.
No user-visible treatment or real-user outcome changed.

remainingRisks.nextBlockingDependency: The current prose-first top-insight contract requires bounded authorized communication and upstream priority before disclosure becomes the sole activation blocker.
remainingRisks.remainingDiscoveryPhase: Phase 8 compatibility remains inactive; broader Phase 5 Governance and Phase 6 remain paused.
remainingRisks.remainingBenchmarkGap: Active browser behavior, user comprehension, decision validity, and revocation-in-application remain unmeasured.

rollback.description: Remove the compatibility adapter and its optional contract metadata, validator, command, report, and documentation; the active Phase 8A adapter and Runtime remain unchanged.

engineeringDecision.rationale: Accept the inactive adapter and refine the product communication and priority contract before implementing disclosure activation.
